_about: Where each material may spawn when the world is generated (A2). scripts/spawn_regions.gd reads this.
Materials are named, not numbered. A name the material table does not know yet is skipped, so a
row can be written ahead of the material it names.
Existing features (veins, seams, aquifers, caves, pockets) still come from worldgen.gd and keep each
seed's layout; this table places what is added on top of them.
areas: named places, built before the spawns that use them.
mound: a heap of `fill` standing on the ground beside the anchor. anchor 'hub' is the Hub's middle;
dx = [min, max] cells off it, side picked per seed; width and height are [min, max] cells.
patch: a ragged ellipse inside a home range. x = [min, max] as fractions of the world's width,
depth = [min, max] rows (a depth band), size = [rx, ry] cells. Biomes (A6) are patches.
spawns: one row each.
material: a material name.  area: a name from areas, or 'world' (the default).
x, depth: the home range, as above (area 'world' only; an area brings its own).
host: names it may replace; nothing else is touched.
clumps: [min, max] how many; radius: [min, max] cells; shape: blob (a ragged ellipse) or
speckle (a loose scatter of single cells, `density` 0-1 of the disc). aspect: squashes a blob
into a seam or vein, `radius` cells either way across and radius / aspect up and down.
Wave 1 rows (the second half of the list) follow claude/WAVE1_MATERIALS.md's home table.
Ferrite sits above the Sulfur band (A5): three seams anywhere across the world, and a fourth in the Hub's middle
third, so a straight shaft meets one before the casing needs Plating. It is the last row, so adding it moved nothing else.
Wave 2 rows (A5 part 3, the last seven): Brine, Salt and Chlor in the Stone band, Lumen, Veinstone, Gall and Vitriol in and under the
Magma band's top. Lye, Lift, Pitch, Chillant and Filings are made, not found. Added last, so no earlier row moved.
enabled: false parks a row.
